name: Grunge Editorial
summary: Layered, distressed type, overprinted photographs and broken columns, set by hand in early Macintosh software. David Carson at Ray Gun and the Emigre studio made it the look of 1990s alternative music and youth magazines.

philosophy.core_thesis: Legibility is not the same as communication, and a page can carry the mood of its content by looking as rough as the content feels.
design_principles: Layer type over type and type over photographs with 2 to 4 overlapping text layers, and let the overlaps cut the legibility by 10% to 30%.
Mix 3 to 5 typefaces on one spread, at least one of them a distressed or bitmap face, and change size by a ratio of 3 or more.
Break the column grid: set one text block at an angle of 90 degrees, or one block with a line length of 12 characters, or one at 120 characters.
Add texture to every surface: scanner noise, photocopy grain, torn paper edges and halftone dots at 4px to 8px pitch.
Crop photographs hard, blur or posterise them, and print them at 60% to 100% contrast over a flat dark field.
Treat the page number, folio and caption as display type, at 48px to 200px.
Hold the palette to black, off-white and one or two dirty hues, and leave ink edges uneven.
anti_patterns: A single neutral sans serif with one weight
Perfect modular grids with equal gutters
Glossy gradients and polished vector shadows
Stock photography on a white field
Generous empty margins with a centred headline

layout.grid_mechanics: A nominal 3-column grid with 12px gutters that the content breaks on purpose; 1 in 3 blocks sits off the column by 16px to 120px or rotates by 90 degrees.
layout.whitespace_ratio: Only 5% to 15% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 4, 12, 28, 60px and gaps vary within a page.
layout.alignment_rules: Mix flush-left, flush-right, rotated and justified blocks on one page; overlap text blocks by 8px to 40px and bleed photographs off at least two page edges.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles with 0px radius and torn or cropped edges; panels are photograph crops and taped paper strips, with no card chrome.

font_pairings.note: Broken display letters over a typewriter text face.
A worn typewriter display with a clean mono for captions.
A heavy blunt sans against a transitional serif.
Bitmap display type with a typewriter body.

typography.tracking: Display sizes range from -0.06em to +0.3em within one page; body stays between 0em and +0.05em.
typography.leading: Display 0.8 to 1.0 with overlapping lines; body 1.2 to 1.4; captions 1.0.
hierarchy_rules: Use 3 to 5 sizes with jumps of 3x or more, from 9px captions to 180px display words.
Mix upper case, lower case and small caps in one headline, and set one word 3x larger than the rest.
Rotate or stack one text block per spread at 90 degrees, and keep body paragraphs horizontal.
Keep body text at 11px to 14px in mono or serif and let headlines break the text frame.

color.palette_structure: Black and warm off-white carry 70% of the surface; one or two muddy hues cover 20% as overprint, and one acid accent covers under 5%.
color.contrast_rules: Body text holds 7:1 or better; display type may fall to 2:1 where it overlaps an image, and then a body-size caption must repeat the words at 7:1.
color.surface_treatment: Textured, uneven and ink-heavy: grain at 15% to 30% opacity, multiply blend for overprint and a 1px to 3px misregistration offset between colour layers.
color.light_and_shadow: No coherent light source; depth comes from overlap order and multiply blending, and shadows, where present, are hard offsets of 2px to 4px in a darker ink.

materiality.surface_simulation: Photocopied newsprint and cheap offset stock, with scanner dust, tape, staples and torn edges.
materiality.border_rules: Rough ink rules of 1px to 6px that break or fade at one end; boxes are drawn by hand or omitted.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Blur is used on photographs only, at a radius of 2px to 6px, and elevation is a single paper layer with a 3px hard shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Crude hand-cut marks, arrows and crosses with a 2px to 5px uneven stroke and no consistent corner style; few of them.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Collage of scanned photographs, hand lettering, found type and scribbles; images are posterised, blurred or cut into strips.

motion.transition_physics: Translation for screen: layers cut in with a stutter, shift by 2px to 6px and flicker between two states, like a photocopy that is fed through twice.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover offsets the colour layer by 3px and swaps the face to a distressed cut; active inverts black and newsprint and rotates the block by 1 degree.

emotion.target_response: Raw immediacy: the viewer feels close to an unpolished, noisy scene and reads the page as a document made by people, not by a brand.

avoid_when: The user must read long passages or complete a task with forms and tables.
The brand needs a calm, institutional or medical tone.
The page must meet a strict accessibility audit, since overlaps cut legibility below 4.5:1.

modifiers.how: Snap blocks to a 12-column grid, drop overlaps and texture, and keep one oversized headline and the black and off-white palette.
Replace paper grain with chrome and gloss gradients, and keep the layered type and the mixed faces; use clean vector edges.
Add 3px black borders and hard offset shadows to the blocks and flatten the texture; keep the overlaps and the mono body.
